items.title: Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH
items.title_zh: 数学家抢在 Anthropic 公告后数小时内仓促发布酝酿12年的 GRH 证明草稿
items.title_en: Mathematician rush-posts 12-year GRH proof draft hours after Anthropic announcement
items.summary: A mathematician hurriedly posts a 12-year-in-the-making draft claiming a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis within hours of an Anthropic announcement, sparking debate over verification, priority, and AI-vs-human discovery.

items.title: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis [pdf]
items.title_zh: Levent Alpöge 宣称证明广义黎曼猜想
items.title_en: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
items.summary: Levent Alpöge has posted a claimed proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, sparking intense discussion about its validity, massive Lean formalization, and the role of AI and human mathematicians.

items.title: Unforced Navier-Stokes Singularity and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: 陶哲轩：无外力欧拉与纳维-斯托克斯奇点及广义黎曼猜想
items.title_en: Terry Tao: Unforced Euler/Navier–Stokes Singularity and Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
items.summary: A Terry Tao blog post claiming unforced Navier-Stokes/Euler singularity results and a route to the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, discussed on Hacker News alongside questions about Lean formal verification trust and AI-driven mathematics.

items.title: Inkling 2 Mini
items.title_zh: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Mini 循环式 Transformer 模型
items.title_en: Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Mini Looped Transformer
items.summary: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, a looped-transformer LLM trained end-to-end in nvfp4 and designed for local use, drawing strong community interest and hands-on benchmarking.

items.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
items.title_zh: 语言模型靠推理改写自身权重，无需梯度也无需训练
items.title_en: LLM rewrites its own weights through reasoning, no gradients needed
items.summary: An arXiv paper claims a language model can improve itself by rewriting its own weights via reasoning without gradients or training, sparking debate over novelty, whether it's really training, and safety risks.

items.title: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations
items.title_zh: Buckmaster 仓库宣称无外力 Navier–Stokes 方程有限时间爆破
items.title_en: Buckmaster repo claims unforced Navier–Stokes finite-time blow-up
items.summary: A Hacker News post links to a GitHub repository claiming finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations, with discussion treating it as a major mathematical result.

items.title: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data
items.title_zh: Signal 限制移动端截图，阻止系统级 AI 智能体读取聊天内容
items.title_en: Signal blocks mobile screenshots to keep OS-level AI agents out of chats
items.summary: Signal discusses efforts to restrict AI agents and mobile operating systems from capturing private user data, prompting debate about platform control, transparency, and screenshot usability.

items.title: The stochastic parrots have apparently proved the Riemann Hypothesis
items.title_zh: Scott Aaronson 谈“随机鹦鹉”与黎曼猜想的所谓证明
items.title_en: Scott Aaronson on 'Stochastic Parrots' and a Claimed Riemann Hypothesis Proof
items.summary: Scott Aaronson discusses claims that stochastic-parrot-style LLMs have 'proved' the Riemann Hypothesis and what that means for AI, mathematical understanding, and explanation.

items.title: KVM 漏洞致 AMD 主机内存可被虚拟机读取
items.title_zh: Linux KVM 漏洞 CVE-2026-99312 致 AMD 主机内存可被虚拟机读取
items.title_en: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Exposes AMD Host Memory to Guest VMs
items.summary: CVE-2026-99312 in Linux KVM allows virtual machines to read host memory on AMD systems with nested virtualization enabled, with upstream fixes released but many distro kernels still vulnerable.

items.title: 🤖 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Neon 模型  谷歌推出 Gemini 4 Neon，主打复杂软件工程、知识工作与科研工作流的快速端到端执行，已向开发者、企业
items.title_zh: 谷歌据称发布 Gemini 4 Neon，主打编程与科研工作流
items.title_en: Google Reportedly Launches Gemini 4 Neon for Coding and Research Workflows
items.summary: Google reportedly launched Gemini 4 Neon, a frontier model targeting complex software engineering, knowledge work, and research workflows, claiming top rankings on the Artificial Analysis coding-agent index at $3/$15 per million input/output tokens with a 1M-token context window.
